_comment: PROVENANCE PIN for the primary's compose REFUSAL vectors, which are pinned
SEPARATELY from the rest of the compose corpus. Generated by
WHY A SECOND PIN AND NOT A RE-VENDOR. compose_vectors.provenance.json pins
the whole corpus at ONE commit, and the commit this vector arrives on
(md-codec 0.45.0) also carries md-codec 0.44.0, `a rendered xpub's header
must agree with its origin`, which rewrote the xpubs in all 33
keyed_compose_*.conformance.json records. That rule is not ported here.
MEASURED, because the reason has to be a fact and not a worry: a full
re-vendor to 4de55155 leaves `go test ./md/` GREEN -- the conformance gate
parses .chains[].descriptor into a struct field it never asserts, so it
cannot see the rewrite. A fresh pin would therefore have imported an
unported normative change with every gate still reporting agreement. The
corpus stays at its own commit until 0.44.0 is ported on purpose; this
